Subtracting backward squared weights gives (1-r^(2k))²/((1+r^(2n))(1+r^(2(k-n)))), equal to L_a/(cosh a+cosh(b(2n-k))). The count is precisely the number of integers in an open interval of length A_a(t)/b, with discrepancy <=1. Layer cake gives the uniform |Tr(D^p)-kW_p(a)|<=c_a^p, including p<1, and direct integration/telescoping gives W1,W2 and all stated limits. Even/odd peaks follow by minimizing |2n-k|. Independent rational diagonal identities and bounded real counting checks passed; analytic bounds prove all parameters.
